26154-the-joyous-adventures-of-aristide-.title: Of Aristide Pujol
26154-the-joyous-adventures-of-aristide-.creator: William J. Locke
26154-the-joyous-adventures-of-aristide-.description: A book by William J. Locke. In narrating these few episodes in the undulatory, not to say switchback, career of my friend Aristide Pujol, I can pretend to no chronological sequence. Some occurred before he (almost literally) crossed my path for the first time, some afterwards.

36151-franklin-s-autobiography-eclectic-.title: Franklin S Autobiography Eclectic English Classics
36151-franklin-s-autobiography-eclectic-.creator: Unknown
36151-franklin-s-autobiography-eclectic-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. His boyhood in Boston was a stern beginning of the habit of hard work and rigid economy which marked the man. For a year he went to the Latin Grammar School on School Street, but left off at the age of ten to help his father in making soap and candles. He persisted in showing such "bookish inclination," however, that at twelve his father apprenticed him to learn the printer's trade. At seventeen he ran off to Philadelphia and there began his independent career.

58856-throne-makers.title: Throne-Makers
58856-throne-makers.creator: William Roscoe Thayer
58856-throne-makers.description: A book by William Roscoe Thayer. and he will not rest until he has changed them into an implement to save the labor of many hands; the Prussian takes flesh and blood, and the will-power latent therein, and converts them into a machine. Such soldiers, such government clerks, such administrators, have never been manufactured elsewhere. Methodical, punctilious, thorough, are those officers and officials.

67826-contraband-a-tale-of-modern-smuggl.title: A Tale of Modern Smugglers
67826-contraband-a-tale-of-modern-smuggl.creator: E. R. Spencer
67826-contraband-a-tale-of-modern-smuggl.description: A book by E. R. Spencer. he could gain sanctuary. Once he reached the smoke-room he had to exert all his strength to open the door, which was pressed to as with a vice by the weight of the wind. He managed to get it open enough to slip inside, when the door closed precipitately behind him and knocked him half-way across the room. He was helped to his feet by the chief engineer, who was seated at a card-table with the captain and two passengers.

76845-the-golden-pool.creator: R. Austin Freeman
76845-the-golden-pool.description: A book by R. Austin Freeman. “great events from little causes spring”; but we do not realise, until we actually submit our experiences to analysis, how the whole tenour and meaning of our lives has in many cases been determined by some occurrence so unimportant that, at the time, it appears incredible that it should have any consequences at all.

arxiv-2201-07445.title: Arc length preserving approximation of circular arcs by Pythagorean-hodograph curves of degree seven Journal: Computer Aided Geometric Design
arxiv-2201-07445.creator: Emil Žagar
arxiv-2201-07445.description: Abstract In this paper interpolation of two planar points, corresponding tangent directions and curvatures with Pythagorean-hodograph (PH) curves of degree seven preserving an arc length is considered. A general approach using complex representation of PH curves is presented and a detailed analysis of the problem for data arising from a circular arc is provided.

arxiv-2206-10132.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xue-Chao Feng, Zheng-Ya Li, De-Min Li, Qin-Tao Song, En Wang, Wen-Cheng Yan. Although there are some experimental hints for the higher excited ρ \rho mesons, our knowledge of their properties is much poor theoretically.

arxiv-2309-10718.title: DRIVE: Data-driven Robot Input Vector Exploration
arxiv-2309-10718.creator: Dominic Baril, Simon-Pierre Deschênes, Luc Coupal, Cyril Goffin, Julien Lépine, Philippe Giguère, François Pomerleau
arxiv-2309-10718.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Dominic Baril, Simon-Pierre Deschênes, Luc Coupal, Cyril Goffin, Julien Lépine, Philippe Giguère, François Pomerleau. An accurate motion model is a fundamental component of most autonomous navigation systems. While much work has been done on improving model formulation, no standard protocol exists for gathering empirical data required to train models. In this work, we address this issue by proposing DRIVE ( DRIVE ), a protocol that enables characterizing UGV input limits and gathering empirical model training data.

arxiv-2312-03000.title: VidereX: A Navigational Application inspired by ants
arxiv-2312-03000.creator: Nam Ho Koh 1 , Doran Amos 2 , Paul Graham 3 , Andrew Philippides 3
arxiv-2312-03000.description: Abstract Navigation is a crucial element in any person’s life, whether for work, education, social living or any other miscellaneous reason; naturally, the importance of it is universally recognised and valued. One of the critical components of navigation is vision, which facilitates movement from one place to another.

arxiv-2412-02066.title: CLERF: Contrastive LEaRning for Full Range Head Pose Estimation
arxiv-2412-02066.creator: Ting-Ruen Wei, Haowei Liu, Huei-Chung Hu, Xuyang Wu, Yi Fang, Hsin-Tai Wu
arxiv-2412-02066.description: Abstract We introduce a novel framework for representation learning in head pose estimation (HPE). Previously such a scheme was difficult due to head pose data sparsity, making triplet sampling infeasible. Recent progress in 3D generative adversarial networks (3D-aware GAN) has opened the door for easily sampling triplets (anchor, positive, negative).

arxiv-2503-22166.title: Reasoning of Large Language Models over Knowledge Graphs with Super-Relations Thanks: $†$ Work done when Song Wang was visiting MIT CSAIL and the MIT-IBM AI Watson Lab.
arxiv-2503-22166.creator: Song Wang, Junhong Lin, Xiaojie Guo, Julian Shun, Jundong Li, Yada Zhu
arxiv-2503-22166.description: Abstract While large language models (LLMs) have made significant progress in processing and reasoning over knowledge graphs, current methods suffer from a high non-retrieval rate. This limitation reduces the accuracy of answering questions based on these graphs. Our analysis reveals that the combination of greedy search and forward reasoning is a major contributor to this issue.

arxiv-2508-03591.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Benjamin M. Harless, Jasmine K. Sindelar, J. Daniel Gezelter. arxiv-2508-13770.title: Generative Super-Resolution of Turbulent Flows via Stochastic Interpolants
arxiv-2508-13770.creator: Martin Schiødt, Nikolaj T. Mücke, Clara M. Velte
arxiv-2508-13770.description: Abstract Capturing the intricate multiscale features of turbulent flows remains a fundamental challenge due to the limited resolution of experimental data and the computational cost of high-fidelity simulations. In many practical scenarios only coarse representations of the flows are feasible, leaving crucial fine-scale dynamics unresolved.

arxiv-2509-12408.title: Scaffolding Flexible Ideation Workflows with AI in Creative Problem-Solving
arxiv-2509-12408.creator: Yaqing Yang, Vikram Mohanty, Nikolas Martelaro, Aniket Kittur, Yan-Ying Chen, Matthew K. Hong
arxiv-2509-12408.description: Abstract . Divergent thinking in the ideation stage of creative problem - solving demands that individuals explore a broad design space. Yet this exploration rarely follows a neat, linear sequence; problem - solvers constantly shift among searching, creating, and evaluating ideas. Existing interfaces either impose rigid, step - by - step workflows or permit unguided free - form exploration.

arxiv-2512-06027.title: Geometric properties of second Ricci solitons
arxiv-2512-06027.creator: Masoumeh Khalili, Ghodratallah Fasihi-Ramandi, Shahroud Azami
arxiv-2512-06027.description: Abstract . This paper introduce the idea of second Ricci solitons. A second Ricci soliton is nothing but a steady hyperbolic Ricci soliton. We study the geometry of closed and compact second Ricci soliton manifolds. Immersed submanifolds as second solitons also will be investigated. Finally, we investigate this structure on warped product manifolds.

openalex-w7152572309.title: Early Clinical, Laboratory, and Imaging Correlates of Neurological Dysfunction in Adults Presenting to the Emergency Department with Sepsis: A Single-Center Retrospective Study
openalex-w7152572309.creator: Florin Scarlatescu, Ecaterina Scărlătescu, D. Bartos
openalex-w7152572309.description: Objectives: To characterize the prevalence and clinical profile of neurological dysfunction and pure sepsis-associated encephalopathy (SAE) in adults presenting to the emergency department (ED) with sepsis, and to identify early clinical, laboratory, and brain imaging parameters

pmc-11400644.title: Obstetric outcomes in the expectant management of cesarean scar pregnancy with fetal heart activity: a single-center retrospective cohort study
pmc-11400644.creator: Cong Li, Wenyi Chen, Hong Xu, Hong Luo
pmc-11400644.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundCesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) is a high-risk complication characterized by the implantation of a pregnancy within a cesarean scar resulting from a previous delivery. Currently, clinical indicators guiding the expectant management of patients with CSP are lacking.

pmc-11496812.title: Detecting clinical medication errors with AI enabled wearable cameras
pmc-11496812.creator: Justin Chan, Solomon Nsumba, Mitchell Wortsman, Achal Dave, Ludwig Schmidt, Shyamnath Gollakota, Kelly Michaelsen
pmc-11496812.description: Drug-related errors are a leading cause of preventable patient harm in the clinical setting. We present the first wearable camera system to automatically detect potential errors, prior to medication delivery. We demonstrate that using deep learning algorithms, our system can detect and classify drug labels on syringes and vials in drug preparation events recorded in real-world operating rooms.

pmc-11612696.title: Advancing early diagnosis of inflammatory bowel disease: A call for enhanced efforts
pmc-11612696.creator: Shu-Bei He, Bing Hu
pmc-11612696.description: The diagnosis of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is complicated by its nonspecific clinical presentation and the limited accuracy of existing biomarker tests, frequently resulting in significant delays from the time of symptom onset to the achievement of a definitive diagnosis. Thus, improving the early identification of IBD remains a crucial focus for gastroenterologists.

pmc-11686510.title: Rational Fabrication of Functionally-Graded Surfaces for Biological and Biomedical Applications
pmc-11686510.creator: Tong Wu, Xiaoran Li, Jiajia Xue, Younan Xia
pmc-11686510.description: ConspectusAs a ubiquitous feature of the biological world, gradation, in either composition or structure, is essential to many functions and processes. Taking protein gradation as an example, it plays a pivotal role in the development and evolution of human bodies, including stimulation and direction of the outgrowth of peripheral nerves in a developing fetus.

pmc-12649905.title: Human Hepatocytes in Experimental Steatosis: Influence of Donor Sex and Sex Hormones
pmc-12649905.creator: Lena Seidemann, Carolin Marie Rohm, Anna Stilkerich, René Hänsel, Christina Götz, Daniel Seehofer, Georg Damm, Christa Büchler
pmc-12649905.description: Background/Objectives: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is a sexually dimorphic condition, with higher prevalence in men than in women. Sex differences in hepatic lipid metabolism and the modulatory role of sex hormones have been described but are still insufficiently understood.

pmc-12698143.title: Comparison of Emergency Physicians’ and Hospitalists’ Attitudes Toward Fecal Occult Blood Testing in Gastrointestinal Bleeding
pmc-12698143.creator: Doris Ilic, Joseph Bove
pmc-12698143.description: IntroductionThe guaiac fecal occult blood test, originally designed for colorectal cancer screening, is frequently used in emergency departments (ED) to detect occult gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding. However, the test has low sensitivity and specificity, leading to potential false positives and negatives.

pmc-13119218.title: Development of Pseudoginsenoside RT2 as a Novel Gut-Selective Agent: Integrated Pharmacodynamic and Pharmacokinetic Evaluation of an Ocotillol Ginsenoside for Ulcerative Colitis
pmc-13119218.creator: Zhuoqiao Li, Junzhe Wu, Jia Wang, Yuwei Liu, Linxuan Liu, Yiyuan Wang, Yanbo Bu, Xiaoyu Geng, Jinping Liu
pmc-13119218.description: Background/Objectives: Ulcerative colitis is a chronic inflammatory bowel disease marked by a disrupted intestinal barrier and consequent aberrant immune responses. Pseudoginsenoside RT2, an ocotillol-type ginsenoside abundant in Panax herbs, represents a potential therapeutic candidate, yet its anti-ulcerative colitis efficacy and pharmacokinetic profile remain unclear.

pmc-13344122.title: Modified Amberlyst 15 for continuous glycerol-free biodiesel production from rice bran oil fatty acid distillate
pmc-13344122.creator: Tiprawee Tongtummachat, Maturada Suksaard, Kanisorn Toponwised, Kanyanat Prompen, Atchariya Muadchan, Sirinthon Khamphimai, Surachai Chatpatumtong, Attasak Jaree, Nattee Akkarawatkhoosith
pmc-13344122.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study developed a modified Amberlyst 15 (A15) catalyst for the production of glycerol-free biodiesel from rice bran oil fatty acid distillate (RBOFAD), a low-quality feedstock with high free fatty acid content. A15 was selected as the catalyst platform because of its strong Brønsted acidity and good stability; however, its direct application is limited by textural constraints and restricted access to acid sites.

pmc-13548061.creator: Joshua R Heyza, Mariia Mikhova, Cody Phillips, Shomaila Mehmood, Gloria I Perez, David G Broadbent, Jens C Schmidt
pmc-13548061.description: DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs) are highly cytotoxic DNA lesions because they disrupt the connectivity of the DNA strand. Homologous recombination (HR) is a high-fidelity DSB repair pathway that copies the sequence spanning the break from a homologous template, but how DNA ends are held together during HR remains unclear.

pmc-13632281.creator: Xiaqing Zhang, Mingliang Xing, Afen Zhang, Rongzhi Zheng, Huiru Hu, Xianming Zeng
